nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: Papa. I went to the print shop last night. I know you told me not to.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: I wanted to look at his desk. Mr Crane's desk. I don't know why. Something felt wrong about him.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: The bottom drawer was locked. I used Mama's hair pin. She taught me how.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: She wrote to him. She trusted him. And he—

choices.text: You did right. Your mother would be proud of you.
Don't ask me what I'm going to do with this. Go home. Stay with Rosie.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.journal_entry: Thomas found her letter. He used her hair pin to pick the lock. She taught him that. She's still here in everything.

nodes.speaker: Thomas
nodes.text: Papa — are you alright? You're frightening me.
nodes.journal_entry: Thomas is frightened of me now. The same look he gave me when I came home that night. I've become someone he doesn't recognise.
